description: pNEUMA provides naturalistic vehicle trajectories collected by synchronised drones over a congested urban network. The provider is EPFL open-traffic initiative. Geographical and temporal coverage: The pNEUMA initiative describes half a million vehicles in central Athens, Greece. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: This is a bounded urban observation campaign, published as a reusable benchmark. It is not representative of every traffic regime. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
